_comment: Configuration for research/instruments/runner/runner.py. Everything here is a
declaration of what THIS machine and THIS build look like; nothing here is a
fact about the game and nothing here carries an evidence grade. Facts live in
research/ with their oracle and confidence.
build.expected_sha256 must equal the sha256 of the live MISERY-Win64-Shipping.exe.
It is duplicated from research/builds/index.json on purpose: the runner fails
closed on a mismatch, and a mismatch is exactly the signal that Steam updated
the game (it has happened once already -- RESEARCH_LOG LOG-0048).
COMPUTED by research/instruments/mods/stage_from_plan.py from the Stage 4
load plan -- do not hand-edit the stage list. The mods under the
discovery root declare their own content; this file only records what
that resolved to for the next runner cycle.
load_order at generation time: alphamod, betamod
Entries not produced by a mod are listed in that script's LEGACY_*
constants, each with a reason.
strategy: ui | keyboard | manual | none. See saveentry.py for the ladder.
'ui' is the state machine: it classifies the screen from the live object
graph, sends that screen's one declared action, waits for an observable
signature change, and reclassifies. An unrecognised screen stops the cycle
with its measured signature attached -- it never guesses a key.
ui_states=null uses the table measured against this build in saveentry.py.
save_entry._timeout_note: 240s because one of these transitions is a level load, not a panel swap; the check is still observational (signature change), the timeout only bounds it.

_comment: The gameplay invariants readiness.prove_gameplay is held to. authority is
'standalone' or 'networked'; world_name null means any world is accepted.
expect._measured: live object counts measured on build bace50f7185d: 26263 at the thank-you screen (WD_PlaytestNote01_C), 62711 at the main menu, 230007 at the moment the gameplay gate passed. The floor only rejects a half-built graph; the settle window is the real predicate.
expect._save_slot_note: the save slot NAME, as it appears in SaveGameMetaData.sav. The runner computes its row in the load list each cycle (saves.py) instead of clicking a fixed row, because an autosave reorders that list.
